- [2023/05/21] Assistant explains that mahogany ukuleles have a warm, rich tone with balanced mid-range while koa ukuleles are brighter with strong high-end presence. Mahogany has a straight grain pattern whereas koa features curly or flamed patterns.

- [2023/05/21] Assistant describes that the Cordoba 20TM has a rich, full-bodied sound with strong low-end presence due to its tenor body size while the Kala KA-C offers warm, balanced tone with stronger mid-range. The Cordoba is more spacious and comfortable for larger hands.
